deleteExisting.description: Needs to be set to true if files with fileUrlOrEncodedPathPrefix pre-exist

failIfUrlNotEmpty.description: There will be exceptions if files with fileUrlOrEncodedPathPrefix pre-exist

numFiles.description: Number of files into which data must be exported.

doNotRandomizeFileName.description:
If set to true, random string will not be added to the file names
Because S3 supports write-read consistency but only eventual consistency for read-write-read pattern,
We need to make sure the same file which might be read before, would not get written and then read again
